notes:
Fresh animated call UI with a living aurora stage
Friend profile cards now pop in on join and animate out on leave
Solo calls show a polished waiting-for-friend experience
Call presence expires safely after missed heartbeats so stale avatars disappear
New layered sounds for connecting, calling, ringing, joining, leaving, and hang-up
Unread DMs now show per-conversation and total red count badges
Desktop message notifications open the correct conversation
Six saved app font styles are available in Appearance
Direct-message text now uses the sender profile photo reliably
GIF, emoji, and add menus stay above expanded screen shares
Smoother hover, focus, dock, participant, and composer motion throughout Knot
